regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss M. Krausman; you and yours. I am inclined to congratulate you on what seems to be an opportunity of advance- ment. At all events, the old saying: "A change of work is as good as a rest," I hope will apply here in your case. It seems to me that you ought easily be able to convince your present Foreman of the propriety of your accepting the offer of advancement. At the same time show your gratitude his favorable attitude toward your- self as an amployee, i.e., in case you do succeed in the desired promotion. Thanks be to God too for the improved outlook for your dear Father, especially in regard to your Uncle coming back to the source of spiritual strength, our Holy Mother the Church. Deo Gr. I'm sure you will not take it amiss that I so often fail to answer your favors. If I had to answer them all - all my letters I'd be liable to at least lose my ballance.
